summary: Emergency contacts, embassy numbers, and hospitals for South Africa. The country has strong private medical infrastructure but wide gaps between public and private care. Have these numbers saved for Cape Town, Johannesburg, and Durban.

police.description: South African Police Service (SAPS) emergency line
police.notes: From a mobile phone, dial 112. SAPS response quality varies by area. In Cape Town, the City of Cape Town law enforcement can also be reached at 021 480 7700.

ambulance.notes: From mobile: 112. Private ambulance services (Netcare 911, ER24) are significantly faster in urban areas. Netcare 911: 082 911. ER24: 084 124.

fire.notes: Cape Town Fire: 021 480 7700. Johannesburg Fire: 011 375 5911. Report fire via local municipality numbers where possible.

tourist.description: South African Tourism Safety Information Line
tourist.notes: Available for tourist assistance and safety information during office hours.

embassies.name: U.S. Embassy Pretoria
embassies.emergencyNote: After-hours citizen emergencies: call main line and follow the emergency recording to reach duty officer

embassies.name: U.S. Consulate Cape Town
embassies.emergencyNote: After-hours emergencies routed via main number

embassies.name: British High Commission Pretoria
embassies.emergencyNote: Call main number after hours and follow the emergency recording

embassies.name: Canadian High Commission Pretoria
embassies.emergencyNote: Ottawa Emergency Watch and Response Centre for after-hours citizen emergencies

hospitals.name: Groote Schuur Hospital
hospitals.notes: World-famous academic hospital, site of the first heart transplant. Major public trauma and emergency center. Can be crowded but handles serious trauma well.

hospitals.name: Netcare Christiaan Barnard Memorial Hospital
hospitals.address: 181 Longmarket Street, Cape Town City Centre
hospitals.notes: Leading private hospital in Cape Town's CBD. Excellent emergency and cardiac care. Accepts international insurance. Preferred by expats and visitors in the city center.

hospitals.name: Milpark Hospital
hospitals.notes: Top private hospital in Johannesburg. Recognized trauma unit. Accepts international insurance. Covers the airport corridor and northern suburbs.

hospitals.name: Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital
hospitals.notes: KwaZulu-Natal's main academic hospital. Major trauma and emergency center for Durban. Advanced diagnostic and surgical capabilities for a public facility.

insurance.nhis: South Africa does not have a comprehensive national health insurance yet (NHI implementation is ongoing). Public hospitals are government-funded but under severe strain. Private medical care is excellent but expensive without coverage.
insurance.recommendation: Carry comprehensive travel insurance that covers private hospital admission and emergency evacuation. Discovery Health and Netcare are the dominant private networks. Netcare 911 (082 911) and ER24 (084 124) are the gold-standard private ambulance services in urban areas.

keyAlerts: Dial 10111 for police, 10177 for ambulance, or 112 from any mobile
Private ambulances (Netcare 911: 082 911 / ER24: 084 124) respond faster than government EMS in cities
Public hospitals handle serious trauma but private facilities are strongly preferred for non-emergency and planned care
The U.S. has both an Embassy in Pretoria and a Consulate in Cape Town. Use the Cape Town number if you are in the Western Cape
Medical evacuation from South Africa to Europe is significantly more affordable than from other sub-Saharan countries due to flight frequency
